parameters.note: Caples Lake is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b) — only the downstream Caples Creek reach below Caples Lake Dam has a special listing — so the lake itself falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Caples Lake (Region 2, Alpine Co.) for catchable-size Brown Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of May-September. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
